system.description:
This skill can only target a Prop or [Gimmick] with HP. If the target's Rank is equal to or less than your [CR], then it becomes [Incapacitated].

(Fate 1): If the target's Rank is equal to or less than your [CR+2], then it becomes [Incapacitated].

A special skill that cuts through obstructive obstacles with a single stroke. You can cut any hard object by finding the weak point in the object and severing it.
